prompt: Did she ever get back to you about the proposal?

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant with access to tools. When you need information from the workspace, or need to run a command, call the appropriate tool. Once you have enough information to answer, reply directly with the answer in plain text and do NOT call any more tools.
Did she ever get back to you about the proposal?

events.reply:
I don't have any record of a previous conversation about a proposal, or context about who "she" is. Each session starts fresh for me, so I can't track whether someone responded to you.

If you can share more details—who you're waiting to hear from and what the proposal was about—I'm happy to help you draft a follow-up message, review the proposal, or figure out next steps.
